facts.claim: Poseidon of Paros Hotel & Spa (official site, read live) describes itself as a 5-star beachfront hotel at the sandy Golden Beach of Paros (schema address locality: Golden Beach, Paros Island, 84400); its facilities list includes a chapel, a conference centre, a helipad for VIP transfers, two swimming pools plus two smaller children's pools, two pool bars, a beach bar, the Triton sea-view restaurant and a spa. It also describes itself as a family-friendly hotel.

Golden Bay Paros (official site, V.I.P. Services page, read live) says Deluxe Villa One and Deluxe Villa Two are designed to connect into one large residence that can host an important event such as weddings or christenings, and that for this all Golden Bay rooms must be rented, including Suite 1 and Suite 2 on the first floor. Its booking form lists four units (Superior Suite One and Two, Deluxe Villa One and Two). The page does not state the property's area, guest capacity or ceremony options.
facts.conflicts: Area not stated on the page read; the name suggests Golden Beach but this is not confirmed.

facts.claim: Akti Resort (weddingparos.gr, official site, read live) offers a reception hall for weddings and seven rooms, but places itself within walking distance of Kolymbithres beach and 2.5 km from Naoussa, so it is in the north (batch A area), not the east or south coast. Recorded here as out of area for batch C.

Golden Beach Hotel Paros (official site, home page read live, modified 12 September 2024) describes itself as a 3-star beachfront hotel at Golden Beach with 30 modern seaside rooms and apartments, a restaurant serving Greek and Mediterranean cuisine, an all-day bar and its own windsurfing station; its 'Special Events & Weddings' section says it has 40 years of experience in organising weddings and special events, right by Golden Beach. No ceremony options, capacity or exclusive-use terms are stated on the page read.

Poseidon of Paros: a guessed URL (https://www.poseidon-paros.gr/weddings) returned an image (HTTP 415), not a page; the hotel's own sitemap (read live) lists its weddings page at /weddings-reception-organizing, which was then read live (fact_207). The sitemap also lists nine room and suite types, including Junior, Signature and Grand Suites with private pool; the total room count is not stated.

Soros Beach Antiparos (official site, 'Events & Weddings' page read live, modified 6 February 2023): the page's meta description says couples can host an event or their wedding ceremony on its beach, with dinner and drink packages for any celebration; the visible body text speaks of parties and private events on the beach or in the restaurant. Address: Soros Beach, Antiparos 84007. The site also offers rooms and suites (count not stated on this page). No capacity or exclusive-use terms published.
facts.conflicts: Wedding ceremony wording is in the page metadata, not the visible body copy, which only says parties and private events.

facts.claim: Palmtree Events Paros (official site, read live, modified 25 September 2026) describes itself as a villa event venue in Paros for weddings, baptisms and parties, with a 400 square metre villa with sea views, couple accommodation for up to three days, catering, decoration, music and lighting packages, and an 'underwater wedding' option on its booking form. The page does not state which part of Paros it is in or a guest capacity, so it cannot be placed in the east and south coast group from this read.

Poseidon of Paros weddings page (official, read live, modified 26 June 2024, page title 'Paros Wedding Venues, Golden Beach') says the hotel sits next to Golden Beach, describes itself as a wedding venue with a chapel, ideal for beachside weddings, says it can cater to all wedding reception needs, and offers receptions by the pool or on Golden Beach, overlooking the Aegean. No guest capacity, ceremony types beyond the chapel, or exclusive-use terms are published on the page.

Golden Beach Hotel Paros weddings page (official, read live, modified 9 April 2021) says it is ideal for beachside weddings and special events with a spectacular Aegean view, cites 40 years of experience organising weddings and events, says it plans weddings, baptisms, follow-up receptions and private parties, and that 'the estate could support up to 350 people', with a buffet menu, classic seated style or free-style cocktail function. No ceremony location (chapel or beach) or exclusive-use terms are published.
facts.conflicts: The 350 figure is phrased as 'could support up to 350 people' without saying seated or standing; treat as a maximum, not a seated capacity.

facts.claim: The Rooster Antiparos (official 'Events' page, read live) describes itself as a lifestyle and wellness resort and says events there run 'from intimate ceremonies and shared dinners to larger celebrations', in spaces including the Secret Garden, The Bar at sunset, the Farm and the Beach House, handled by an events team. The page does not use the word 'wedding', and publishes no capacity, room count or exclusive-use terms, so it does not meet the inclusion rule (official site saying it hosts weddings).

insider_details.detail: Golden Beach is where both qualifying east-coast hotels sit, and they suit different briefs: Poseidon of Paros has its own chapel and pool or beach receptions, while Golden Beach Hotel publishes the only number in this group (up to 350 people), so a larger guest list starts there; get the seated figure in writing.

Golden Beach is a windsurfing beach (Golden Beach Hotel runs its own windsurfing station), so plan a beach reception with a sheltered pool-terrace or indoor fallback and ask each hotel for its wind plan.
Golden Bay Paros only offers weddings if every unit is rented, so treat it as an exclusive-use villa buyout for a small wedding party, not a guest-hotel block.
For an Antiparos note, Soros Beach is the one property whose own events page names a beach wedding ceremony; confirm this in writing before it is listed.

open_questions.question: Batch C qualifies 2 Paros venues, both at Golden Beach (Poseidon of Paros, Golden Beach Hotel Paros), plus Golden Bay Paros as a conditional reserve (location unconfirmed) and Soros Beach Antiparos for a short Antiparos note (with VERIFY). No qualifying venue found in Drios, Piso Livadi, Logaras or Aliki within the time limit. The Rooster Antiparos excluded (no wedding wording). Akti Resort is north (batch A); Palmtree Events Paros is unplaced.
